en.Pica Library 免费开源。如果你愿意支持后续开发、测试和维护，可以通过: Pica Library is free and open source. If you would like to support continued development, testing, and maintenance, you can sponsor the project voluntarily on AFDIAN. Sponsorship never unlocks extra features, content, or access.
en.装扮包过大；请控制在 7 MB 以内。: Theme pack is too large; keep it under 7 MB.

en.正在新增网盘配置。填写后先“测试连接”，确认无误再保存。: Adding a storage configuration. Fill it in, test the connection, then save it.
en.请先选择并保存本次操作使用的网盘配置: Choose and save a storage configuration for this operation first.
en.已配置多个网盘，请先选择本次扫描/上传使用的目标网盘。: Multiple storage targets are configured. Choose the one to use for this scan/upload.
en.网盘配置已保存。密码已进入 Windows DPAPI 凭据存储。: Storage configuration saved. The password is stored in Windows DPAPI credential storage.
en.正在扫描本地漫画与所选网盘目录…首次扫描会计算文件哈希。: Scanning local comics and the selected storage… The first scan calculates file hashes.
en.等待程序退出: Waiting for the app to exit
en.下载任务已终止，可以重新检查并开始更新。: The download was stopped. You can check again and restart the update.
en.仅支持 PNG / JPEG / WebP 参考图。: Only PNG / JPEG / WebP reference images are supported.
en.只需要写一句你想要的风格并上传角色参考图。网页会把固定提示词、规范、模板和参考图: Describe the style you want and upload character references. Pica Library packages the fixed prompt, specification, template and references for the AI; drop the returned theme pack here to apply it.
en.制作装扮 · Theme Creator Kit: Create a theme · Theme Creator Kit
en.主题描述是唯一必填项；角色图建议 1 张，额外风格图可选。: The theme description is the only required field. One character reference is recommended; extra style references are optional.
en.例如：紫发二次元漫画向导，星空与白猫，薰衣草紫为主色，整体轻盈、可爱，但不要遮抢: Example: a purple-haired manga guide with stars and a white cat, lavender as the main color, light and cute without covering comic covers.
en.把 AI 返回的 .pica-theme 或 ZIP 直接拖入。Desktop: Drop the .pica-theme or ZIP returned by the AI here. Desktop validates it independently and applies it after the safety checks pass.
en.或点击选择文件 · 上限 24 MiB: or click to choose a file · 24 MiB max
en.手机与电脑在同一局域网重新配对/同步一次后，会自动取得 Desktop 的已安装: After the phone reconnects or syncs on the same LAN, it automatically receives Desktop theme packs and follows the active theme.
en.先写一句主题描述。: Write a short theme description first.
en.正在整理固定提示词、规范、模板和参考图…: Packaging the fixed prompt, specification, template and references…
en.正在校验、安装并应用装扮…: Validating, installing and applying the theme…
en.尚未配对手机。完成一次局域网配对后，手机会自动取得 Desktop 的装扮包并跟: No phone is paired yet. Pair once on the LAN and the phone will receive Desktop theme packs and follow the active theme.
en.应用画风信号与最终重排: Applying visual-style signals and final reranking
en.下方暂时保留上一轮推荐；新一轮完成后会自动切换。: The previous recommendations stay visible until the new round finishes, then they switch automatically.
en.下方仍显示上一轮结果，完成后自动切换: Previous results stay visible and switch automatically when complete
en.后台仍在处理；下方不是新结果: Processing continues in the background; the results below are not new yet
en.下方仍是上一轮结果；请查看页面错误提示后重试。: The previous results are still shown. Check the page error and try again.
en.系统会根据收藏和后续真实使用自动学习；只有判断不准确时才需要手动纠正。: The system learns from your collection and later real usage. Manual correction is only needed when its judgment is inaccurate.
en.这里显示推荐策略版本和 revision，主要用于排障与审计。: Shows the recommendation policy version and revision for troubleshooting and audit.
en.这里汇总长期兴趣、最近 30 天和当前会话。长期画像不会因为短期浏览被直接覆盖。: Summarizes long-term interests, the last 30 days and the current session. Short-term browsing does not overwrite the long-term profile.
en.这里读取已经落盘并实际展示的 Final V3 当前批次，不会因为打开本页而重新: Reads the persisted Final V3 batch that is actually being shown. Opening this page does not redistribute recommendations.
en.这是 V5 候选召回实验规划，servingImpact=false；它不是当前: This is the V5 experimental candidate-retrieval plan with servingImpact=false; it is not the batch currently shown to you.
en.这里仅显示你主动覆盖系统判断的项目。屏蔽偏好和屏蔽具体作品会分别统计。: Only items you explicitly override are shown here. Blocked preferences and blocked works are counted separately.
en.0 = 强烈减少，5 = 中性，10 = 非常喜欢。滑杆修改会先暂存，只有点击“: 0 = strongly reduce, 5 = neutral, 10 = strongly prefer. Slider changes are staged until you choose Save adjustments; 0 is still a soft preference, not a block.
en.作者、IP、标签或分类，例如：巨乳: Author, IP, tag or category, e.g. a specific tag
en.推荐审计导出仅在 Windows / Desktop 模式可用。: Recommendation audit export is available only in Windows / Desktop mode.
en.已清除“本次想看”，长期偏好调整保持不变。: Session intent cleared; long-term preference adjustments are unchanged.
en.收藏用于长期画像；Ownership 用于避免把已经拥有的作品继续当作新作推荐；: Favorites build the long-term profile; Ownership prevents already-owned works from being recommended as new; positive evidence can also come from likes and reading behavior.
en.累计收藏和历史行为形成的长期偏好层。: Long-term preferences formed from accumulated favorites and historical behavior.
en.近期层用于识别最近兴趣变化，不会直接覆盖长期画像。: The recent layer detects current shifts without directly overwriting the long-term profile.
en.只统计当前这次打开应用后、appSessionId 相同的有效行为。: Counts only valid behavior from the current app session with the same appSessionId.
en.还没有可读取的实际 serving 批次。: No actual serving batch is available yet.
en.当前批次没有可用归因: No attribution is available for the current batch
en.当前批次没有可展示的具体意图锚点: No specific intent anchors are available for this batch
en.这是 Final V3 已经实际分配并落盘的当前 serving 批次；打开本页: This is the current Final V3 serving batch that has actually been assigned and persisted. Opening this page does not generate or switch batches.
en.按当前批次每本作品的 primaryFamily 汇总，表示这批实际展示结果主要: Summarized by each work’s primaryFamily in the current batch, showing which recommendation intents contributed most to the displayed results.
en.这些锚点来自当前 serving 批次真正使用的 primaryIntent，而: These anchors come from the primaryIntent actually used by the current serving batch, not the V5 Shadow experimental plan.
en.当前没有可读取的 V5 Shadow 规划。: No V5 Shadow plan is available.
en.偏好调整已保存；后续完整重算会同时影响召回与排序。: Preference adjustments saved; the next full recomputation will affect both retrieval and ranking.
en.系统尚未形成稳定判断: The system has no stable judgment yet
en.5/10 是中性起点，可调整到 0–10；修改后仍需点击“保存调整”。: 5/10 is the neutral starting point. Adjust from 0–10, then choose Save adjustments.
en.系统不会因为输入文字就自动创建偏好。确认它确实是标签后再添加。: Typing text does not automatically create a preference. Add it only after confirming it is really a tag.
en.还没有收藏画像也可以先配置推荐。: You can configure recommendations before a collection profile exists.
en.在上方搜索标签并“作为标签添加”，从 5/10 中性起点调整到 0–10；设置为: Search for a tag above, add it as a tag, and adjust from the neutral 5/10 starting point. Tags set to 6–10 can seed the first recommendation round.
en.目前没有手动覆盖，完全使用系统推断。: No manual overrides; using system inference only.
en.滑杆以你的收藏画像为基准；修改会先保存，完整重算后同时影响召回与排序。: The slider starts from your profile baseline. Changes are saved and affect retrieval and ranking after full recomputation.
en.已标记看过 · 当前作品将从新作推荐中隐藏: Marked as seen · hidden from new-work recommendations
en.已标记已有 · 当前作品不再作为新作推荐: Marked as owned · no longer recommended as new
en.已标记重复反馈 · 当前上传将隐藏: Marked as duplicate · this upload will be hidden
en.已暂时隐藏当前作品 · 30 天后自动恢复: Temporarily hidden · automatically returns after 30 days
en.这本作品不该作为新推荐出现: This work should not appear as a new recommendation
en.收藏已保留，但这本不再参与推荐口味画像。: Favorite kept, but this work no longer contributes to your recommendation profile.
en.这本收藏已恢复参与推荐口味画像。: This favorite now contributes to your recommendation profile again.
en.已按你的设置隐藏 · 后续推荐将排除: Hidden by your setting · excluded from future recommendations
en.没有找到可核验的作者身份。: No verifiable author identity was found.
en.先选择归一作者，再进入作品列表。相似名称不会直接静默合并。: Choose a normalized author before opening the works list. Similar names are never silently merged.
en.正在联网补全 Pica / E-H 作者作品…: Fetching more Pica / E-H works online…
en.这个时间段还没有阅读记录。: No reading history in this period.
en.可返回漫画详情重新选择来源。: Return to comic details to choose another source.
en.只读取已冻结的 Visual V1 embedding，不会重建或覆盖向量。人工: Reads only the frozen Visual V1 embeddings and never rebuilds or overwrites vectors. Manual rating: 2=clearly similar, 1=partly similar, 0=clearly dissimilar.
en.Visual V1 QC 尚未读取。点击“刷新”或“随机 Anchor”后才加载: Visual V1 QC is not loaded yet. Use Refresh or Random Anchor to load the current index; opening Settings never starts a scan.
en.相似画风检索超过 20 秒，已停止等待；可稍后重试。: Visual-similarity search exceeded 20 seconds and was stopped; try again later.
en.该漫画不在当前 Visual V1 索引中，不能作为 Anchor。: This work is not in the current Visual V1 index and cannot be used as an Anchor.
en.正在计算 cosine similarity 并读取 Top 12…: Calculating cosine similarity and loading Top 12…
en.Anchor 有向量，但没有可比较结果。: The Anchor has a vector, but there are no comparable results.
en.可以重试；准备阶段正常，之前更像瞬时图片/模型问题。: Retry is reasonable; preparation is normal and the previous issue looks transient.
en.先检查登录、ExH 权限或来源可用性，再重试。: Check login, ExH access or source availability before retrying.
en.重复运行通常无效；保持 pending 比强行封面补齐更合适。: Repeated runs usually do not help; keeping it pending is safer than forcing a cover fallback.
en.少量可重试；持续失败则建议跳过。: A small number can be retried; skip persistent failures.
en.重启桌面后可重试；若固定同一本失败需检查页面格式。: Retry after restarting Desktop; repeated failure on the same work suggests a page-format issue.
en.停止重复运行，先检查磁盘和数据库状态。: Stop repeated runs and check disk/database status first.
en.查看原始错误后决定。: Review the original error before deciding.
en.尚无失败分类记录；可运行“诊断 Pending”。: No classified failures yet; you can run Diagnose Pending.
en.当前 Anchor 没有可比较结果。: The current Anchor has no comparable results.
en.这本漫画没有当前 Visual V1 向量；请从 Visual V1 QC 中选: This work has no current Visual V1 vector; choose an indexed Anchor from Visual V1 QC.
en.欢迎使用新版 Pica Library: Welcome to the new Pica Library
en.花一分钟了解书库、推荐、连接与设置。引导可以随时跳过；之后也可以在“设置 → 帮: Take a minute to see the library, recommendations, connections and settings. You can skip the tour at any time and replay it later from Settings → Help & Onboarding.
en.Pica、E-H、本地下载和远程副本都在这里统一整理。点击“下一步”会真正打开书: Organize Pica, E-H, local downloads and remote copies in one library. Next opens the library itself.
en.可以按标题、作者、标签、来源、存储位置等缩小范围。: Narrow the library by title, author, tags, provider, storage location and more.
en.推荐与在线搜索共用同一套书库身份。下一步会打开推荐页。: Recommendations and online search share the same library identities. Next opens discovery.
en.推荐结合长期收藏、最近行为、显式偏好和本次想看；批次可独立刷新。: Recommendations combine long-term favorites, recent behavior, explicit preferences and current-session intent.
en.语言、推荐、连接、外观、存储和更新都集中在这里。: Language, recommendations, connections, appearance, storage and updates live here.
en.可以查看推荐画像、用 0–10 档纠正偏好，并独立开关画风推荐。: Inspect the recommendation profile, correct preferences on a 0–10 scale, and toggle visual-style recommendations independently.
en.这里管理 Android 配对、跨端同步和 WebDAV。下一步会打开连接设置。: Manage Android pairing, cross-device sync and WebDAV here. Next opens connection settings.
en.手机直接读取电脑内容: Read Desktop content on your phone
en.同一局域网配对后，手机可以直接读取电脑已经下载的漫画，不必重复下载。: After LAN pairing, Android can read comics already downloaded on Desktop without downloading another copy.
en.界面可以随时切换简体中文、日本語和 English，修改会立即保存。: Switch between Simplified Chinese, 日本語 and English at any time; changes are saved immediately.
en.正式版本可以从这里检查更新。以后想重新看本引导，可回到“设置 → 帮助与新手引导: Check formal releases here. You can replay this tour later from Settings → Help & Onboarding.
en.主要功能已经介绍完毕。以后随时可以从设置重新打开本引导。: That covers the main features. You can replay this tour from Settings at any time.
en.之后仍可在“设置 → 帮助与新手引导”重新查看。: You can replay it later from Settings → Help & Onboarding.
en.可以随时重新查看主要功能引导。关闭自动提示后，仍然可以手动启动。: Replay the main feature tour at any time. Turning off automatic prompts never disables manual replay.
